target_builder: Google AI Studio Web Browser (Build -> Android / Kotlin Jetpack Compose)
target_device: Moto G Stylus 5G - 2023 (genevn, LineageOS 24.0 / Android 17 / API 37, zero GMS, Barometer+Gyro+Compass+NFC+BLE+Flash) & Google Play Store (targetSdk 36)
compatibility_rule: DO NOT BUILD if the app cannot run natively on Moto G Stylus 5G (2023) running LineageOS 24.0 (zero GMS/Firebase, no root, no Android-17-restricted APIs); mark skipped_incompatible and advance.
ux_policy: Plain-English normie-friendly labels, 1-line helper text under controls, and beginner How-to-Use tab on every app; acronyms secondary.
distribution_policy: Google Play Store Ready (unique io.github.elizabackrooms.<slug> packageId, targetSdk 36 / Android 16 Play compliance, enableEdgeToEdge, adaptive layouts, runtime permission rationale UI, Privacy Policy URL + in-app Data Safety disclosure, play_store_listing.md, and AI Studio ZIP export)
connectivity_policy: Privacy-by-Default Opt-In Online (android.permission.INTERNET + free keyless public REST APIs via HttpsURLConnection/Coroutines; stateless & offline by default until user opts in to save or sync)
security_policy: Zero PII/secrets/device-IDs/analytics; mandatory pre-upload Security Overseer subagent audit + SHA-256 SECURITY_REVIEW.md sign-off; HTTPS-only TLS (usesCleartextTraffic=false, instanceFollowRedirects=false, 10s timeouts), DNS-checked SSRF blocklist, strict input bounds (BLE/NFC/AFSK/JSON), SecureRandom per-user tokens + Keystore AES-GCM, exported=false internal components, allowBackup=false
